```{r, include=FALSE}
# Check if we have real data, otherwise use mock data for demonstration
USE_MOCK_DATA <- FALSE

tryCatch({
  library(jsonlite)
  results <- fromJSON("results.json")
  ticks_per_second <- results$TimerResolution
  
  # Check if we have sufficient data
  if (is.null(results$Files) || length(results$Files) < 3) {
    USE_MOCK_DATA <<- TRUE
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  USE_MOCK_DATA <<- TRUE
})

if (USE_MOCK_DATA) {
  # Create realistic mock data for demonstration
  ticks_per_second <- 1000000
  
  io_ops <- list(
    "POSIX I/O" = list(Bytes = 5200000000, MetaOperationTime = 520000, TransferOperationTime = 2600000, Count = 12500),
    "MPI I/O" = list(Bytes = 3800000000, MetaOperationTime = 380000, TransferOperationTime = 1900000, Count = 8500),
    "HDF5" = list(Bytes = 2100000000, MetaOperationTime = 420000, TransferOperationTime = 1050000, Count = 3200),
    "ISO C I/O" = list(Bytes = 850000000, MetaOperationTime = 170000, TransferOperationTime = 425000, Count = 1800),
    "netCDF" = list(Bytes = 420000000, MetaOperationTime = 84000, TransferOperationTime = 210000, Count = 920)
  )
  
  files_df <- data.frame(
    FileName = c("/data/output.bin", "/checkpoint/restart.h5", "/input/raw.dat", "/results/summary.nc", 
                 "/logs/app.log", "/temp/buffer.bin", "/shared/collective.dat", "/local/cache.tmp",
                 "/user/data.hdf5", "/scratch/partial.bin"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  files_df$IoParadigm <- I(list(c("POSIX I/O"), c("HDF5"), c("MPI I/O", "POSIX I/O"), c("netCDF", "HDF5"),
                        c("POSIX I/O"), c("ISO C I/O"), c("MPI I/O"), c("POSIX I/O"),
                        c("HDF5"), c("MPI I/O")))
  files_df$Bytes_read <- c(0, 1500000000, 800000000, 200000000, 0, 50000000, 600000000, 0, 300000000, 400000000)
  files_df$Bytes_write <- c(5200000000, 600000000, 1300000000, 220000000, 850000000, 0, 900000000, 420000000, 1200000000, 800000000)
  files_df$Ticks_IO <- c(5200000, 2100000, 2100000, 420000, 850000, 50000, 1500000, 420000, 1500000, 800000)
  files_df$Ticks_meta <- c(520000, 210000, 210000, 42000, 85000, 5000, 150000, 42000, 150000, 80000)
  files_df$Nr_locs <- c(1, 4, 8, 4, 1, 1, 16, 1, 4, 8)
  
  # Access pattern bytes
  files_df$AP_CONTIGUOUS <- c(4500000, 1800000, 0, 350000, 800000, 0, 0, 400000, 1300000, 0)
  files_df$AP_STRIDED <- c(520000, 210000, 1800000, 42000, 0, 45000, 1350000, 0, 100000, 700000)
  files_df$AP_RANDOM <- c(52000, 63000, 210000, 28000, 41500, 0, 150000, 15800, 90000, 92000)
  files_df$AP_NONE <- c(52000, 21000, 21000, 4200, 8500, 500, 15000, 4200, 15000, 8000)
  
  # Access pattern ticks
  files_df$AP_TICKS_CONTIGUOUS <- c(4500, 1800, 0, 350, 800, 0, 0, 400, 1300, 0)
  files_df$AP_TICKS_STRIDED <- c(520, 210, 1800, 42, 0, 45, 1350, 0, 100, 700)
  files_df$AP_TICKS_RANDOM <- c(52, 63, 210, 28, 41, 0, 150, 16, 90, 92)
  files_df$AP_TICKS_NONE <- c(52, 21, 21, 4, 8, 0, 15, 4, 15, 8)
  
  results <- list(
    Trace = list(FileName = "mock_trace.otf2"),
    ProcessCount = 16,
    TimerResolution = ticks_per_second,
    IOOperations = io_ops,
    Files = files_df
  )
  
  cat("Using mock data for demonstration\n")
} else {
  # Use real data - convert to standard format
  files_df <- results$Files
  files_df$Bytes_read <- as.numeric(files_df$`#Bytes read`)
  files_df$Bytes_write <- as.numeric(files_df$`#Bytes write`)
  files_df$Ticks_IO <- as.numeric(files_df$`Ticks spent on I/O`)
  files_df$Ticks_meta <- as.numeric(files_df$`Ticks spent on Metadata`)
  files_df$Nr_locs <- as.numeric(files_df$`Nr accesses from different locations`)
  
  # Extract access pattern columns - handle both naming conventions
  ap_bytes <- files_df$`I/O sizes per Access Pattern`
  ap_ticks <- files_df$`Ticks spent per Access Pattern`
  
  if (!is.null(ap_bytes)) {
    cn <- colnames(ap_bytes)
    files_df$AP_CONTIGUOUS <- as.numeric(ap_bytes[, grep("CONTIGUOUS", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
    files_df$AP_STRIDED <- as.numeric(ap_bytes[, grep("STRIDED", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
    files_df$AP_RANDOM <- as.numeric(ap_bytes[, grep("RANDOM", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
    files_df$AP_NONE <- as.numeric(ap_bytes[, grep("NONE", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
    
    files_df$AP_TICKS_CONTIGUOUS <- as.numeric(ap_ticks[, grep("CONTIGUOUS", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
    files_df$AP_TICKS_STRIDED <- as.numeric(ap_ticks[, grep("STRIDED", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
    files_df$AP_TICKS_RANDOM <- as.numeric(ap_ticks[, grep("RANDOM", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
    files_df$AP_TICKS_NONE <- as.numeric(ap_ticks[, grep("NONE", cn)[1], drop=TRUE])
  } else {
    files_df$AP_CONTIGUOUS <- 0
    files_df$AP_STRIDED <- 0
    files_df$AP_RANDOM <- 0
    files_df$AP_NONE <- 0
    files_df$AP_TICKS_CONTIGUOUS <- 0
    files_df$AP_TICKS_STRIDED <- 0
    files_df$AP_TICKS_RANDOM <- 0
    files_df$AP_TICKS_NONE <- 0
  }
  
  results$Files <- files_df
  cat("Using real data from results.json\n")
}

format_bytes <- function(bytes) {
  if (is.na(bytes)) return("0 B")
  bytes <- as.numeric(bytes)
  if (bytes >= 1e15) return(sprintf("%.2f PB", bytes / 1e15))
  if (bytes >= 1e12) return(sprintf("%.2f TB", bytes / 1e12))
  if (bytes >= 1e9)  return(sprintf("%.2f GB", bytes / 1e9))
  if (bytes >= 1e6)  return(sprintf("%.2f MB", bytes / 1e6))
  if (bytes >= 1e3)  return(sprintf("%.2f KB", bytes / 1e3))
  return(sprintf("%d B", bytes))
}

format_time <- function(ticks) {
  if (is.na(ticks)) return("0 s")
  ticks <- as.numeric(ticks)
  seconds <- ticks / ticks_per_second
  if (seconds >= 3600) return(sprintf("%.2f h", seconds / 3600))
  if (seconds >= 60)   return(sprintf("%.2f min", seconds / 60))
  if (seconds >= 1)    return(sprintf("%.2f s", seconds))
  if (seconds >= 1e-3) return(sprintf("%.2f ms", seconds * 1e3))
  if (seconds >= 1e-6) return(sprintf("%.2f µs", seconds * 1e6))
  return(sprintf("%.2f ns", seconds * 1e9))
}
```

## Overview

```{r, results="asis"}
# Compute summary metrics
io_ops <- results$IOOperations
total_bytes <- sum(sapply(io_ops, function(x) ifelse(is.null(x$Bytes), 0, x$Bytes)), na.rm = TRUE)
total_ops <- sum(sapply(io_ops, function(x) ifelse(is.null(x$Count), 0, x$Count)), na.rm = TRUE)
num_files <- nrow(results$Files)

cat("\n\n| Metric | Value |\n|--------|-------|\n")
cat(sprintf("| Total I/O | %s |\n", format_bytes(total_bytes)))
cat(sprintf("| I/O Operations | %d |\n", total_ops))
cat(sprintf("| Files Accessed | %d |\n", num_files))
cat(sprintf("| Processes | %d |\n", results$ProcessCount))
cat(sprintf("| Timer Resolution | %.2f ms |\n", results$TimerResolution / 1e6))
cat(sprintf("| Trace File | %s |\n", results$Trace$FileName))
cat("\n\n")
```

## I/O by Paradigm

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
# Prepare paradigm data
paradigms <- names(io_ops)
bytes_vec <- as.numeric(sapply(io_ops, function(x) ifelse(is.null(x$Bytes), 0, x$Bytes)))
meta_vec <- as.numeric(sapply(io_ops, function(x) ifelse(is.null(x$MetaOperationTime), 0, x$MetaOperationTime))) / ticks_per_second
transfer_vec <- as.numeric(sapply(io_ops, function(x) ifelse(is.null(x$TransferOperationTime), 0, x$TransferOperationTime))) / ticks_per_second

# Professional color palette
colors <- c("#3498db", "#e67e22", "#9b59b6", "#1abc9c", "#f39c12")

# Plot all three metrics side by side
par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(5, 14, 4, 2))

# Bytes
idx <- order(bytes_vec, decreasing = TRUE)
barplot(bytes_vec[idx], names.arg = paradigms[idx], horiz = TRUE, 
        xlab = "Bytes", main = "(a) I/O Size per Paradigm",
        col = colors[seq_along(bytes_vec)], las = 1)

# Transfer Time
idx <- order(transfer_vec, decreasing = TRUE)
barplot(transfer_vec[idx], names.arg = paradigms[idx], horiz = TRUE,
        xlab = "Time (s)", main = "(b) Transfer Time per Paradigm",
        col = colors[seq_along(transfer_vec)], las = 1)

# Meta Time
idx <- order(meta_vec, decreasing = TRUE)
barplot(meta_vec[idx], names.arg = paradigms[idx], horiz = TRUE,
        xlab = "Time (s)", main = "(c) Meta I/O Time per Paradigm",
        col = colors[seq_along(meta_vec)], las = 1)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## Local Access Patterns

*Analysis of per-file I/O access patterns (CONTIGUOUS, STRIDED, RANDOM, NONE)*

```{r, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
# Aggregate access pattern data
files <- results$Files

cont_bytes <- sum(files$AP_CONTIGUOUS, na.rm = TRUE)
strd_bytes <- sum(files$AP_STRIDED, na.rm = TRUE)
rand_bytes <- sum(files$AP_RANDOM, na.rm = TRUE)
none_bytes <- sum(files$AP_NONE, na.rm = TRUE)

cont_ticks <- sum(files$AP_TICKS_CONTIGUOUS, na.rm = TRUE)
strd_ticks <- sum(files$AP_TICKS_STRIDED, na.rm = TRUE)
rand_ticks <- sum(files$AP_TICKS_RANDOM, na.rm = TRUE)
none_ticks <- sum(files$AP_TICKS_NONE, na.rm = TRUE)

ap_names <- c("CONTIGUOUS", "STRIDED", "RANDOM", "NONE")
ap_bytes_vec <- c(cont_bytes, strd_bytes, rand_bytes, none_bytes)
ap_ticks_vec <- c(cont_ticks, strd_ticks, rand_ticks, none_ticks)

# Plot both Time and Bytes side by side
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(5, 14, 4, 2))

# Time by pattern
idx <- order(ap_ticks_vec, decreasing = TRUE)
barplot(ap_ticks_vec[idx], names.arg = ap_names[idx], horiz = TRUE,
        xlab = "Ticks (scaled)", main = "I/O Ticks by Access Pattern",
        col = colors[seq_along(ap_names)], las = 1)

# Bytes by pattern  
idx <- order(ap_bytes_vec, decreasing = TRUE)
barplot(ap_bytes_vec[idx], names.arg = ap_names[idx], horiz = TRUE,
        xlab = "Bytes", main = "I/O Size by Access Pattern",
        col = colors[seq_along(ap_names)], las = 1)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### Per-File Access Pattern Breakdown

```{r, results="asis", fig.width=12}
# Print detailed table
files <- results$Files

cat("\n\n| File | Read | Write | CONTIGUOUS | STRIDED | RANDOM | NONE |\n")
cat("|--------|----------|----------|------------|----------|--------|------|\n")

for (i in 1:nrow(files)) {
  fname <- basename(as.character(files$FileName[i]))
  if (nchar(fname) == 0) next
  
  read_b <- format_bytes(files$Bytes_read[i])
  write_b <- format_bytes(files$Bytes_write[i])
  cont_b <- format_bytes(files$AP_CONTIGUOUS[i])
  strd_b <- format_bytes(files$AP_STRIDED[i])
  rand_b <- format_bytes(files$AP_RANDOM[i])
  none_b <- format_bytes(files$AP_NONE[i])
  
  cat(sprintf("| %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s | %s |\n",
              substr(fname, 1, 25), read_b, write_b, cont_b, strd_b, rand_b, none_b))
}
cat("\n\n")
```

## Global Access Pattern Analysis

*How I/O patterns vary based on number of MPI ranks accessing each file*

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Aggregate by number of locations
files <- results$Files
loc_agg <- aggregate(cbind(Bytes_read, Bytes_write, Nr_locs) ~ Nr_locs, data = files, FUN = sum)
loc_agg$TotalBytes <- loc_agg$Bytes_read + loc_agg$Bytes_write
loc_agg <- loc_agg[order(-loc_agg$TotalBytes), ]
loc_agg$Label <- paste0(loc_agg$Nr_locs, ifelse(loc_agg$Nr_locs == 1, " rank", " ranks"))

# Plot by location count
par(mar = c(5, 14, 4, 2))
barplot(loc_agg$TotalBytes, names.arg = loc_agg$Label, horiz = TRUE,
        xlab = "Bytes", main = "I/O by Number of Accessing Ranks",
        col = "#3498db", las = 1)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
```

### Files by Rank Count

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
# Count files per rank
file_count <- aggregate(FileName ~ Nr_locs, data = files, FUN = length)
file_count <- file_count[order(-file_count$FileName), ]
file_count$Label <- paste0(file_count$Nr_locs, ifelse(file_count$Nr_locs == 1, " rank", " ranks"))

par(mar = c(5, 14, 4, 2))
barplot(file_count$FileName, names.arg = file_count$Label, horiz = TRUE,
        xlab = "File Count", main = "Number of Files by Accessing Ranks",
        col = "#e67e22", las = 1)
par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2))
```
